latest.title: Contract Wins and Uplifts Totalling £24m
latest.content:
26 Aug 2026 07:00
RNS Number : 1322S
TPXimpact Holdings PLC
26 August 2026
26 August 2026
TPXimpact Holdings PLC
("TPXimpact", "TPX" or the "Group" or the "Company")
Contract Wins and Uplifts Totalling £24m
£19m contract uplift and one year extension secured with HM Land Registry and new £5m British Library award
TPXimpact Holdings PLC (AIM: TPX), a leading technology-enabled services company focused on people-powered digital transformation, is pleased to announce two significant contract developments with a combined value of
£24 million
.
HM Land Registry: £19m Contract Uplift
TPXimpact has secured a
£19 million contract uplift
and one year extension under its ongoing strategic delivery partnership with His Majesty's Land Registry (HMLR), extending the contract to May 2028. This extension builds on TPXimpact's appointment in May 2023 as HMLR's primary Digital, Data, and Technology (DDaT) Delivery Partner, originally awarded as a four-year contract to May 2027. The contract was awarded via an open and transparent process using the Government Commercial Agency (GCA) framework. This extension was included as part of the original contract.
The expanded funding reflects the ongoing growth and success of the joint delivery model, as TPXimpact and HMLR work together to modernise casework systems and accelerate HMLR's transition to a digital-first organisation.
British Library: £5m Contract Win
The Group's digital experience agency,
manifesto
, has recorded its largest ever win, having been selected as the successful bidder to provide digital product development services for the
British Library
as part of its landmark Future Web Programme.
●
Initial Contract Value:
£5 million
●
Contract Duration:
Initial 30-month term, with options to extend
●
Services:
Digital product development, maintenance, and ongoing enhancement of the British Library's web estate via an agile delivery model.
manifesto will supply a multidisciplinary delivery team working alongside British Library staff to modernise the British Library's digital services, expand online access to its collections, and provide a flexible delivery capability tailored to evolving programme needs.
Bjӧrn Conway, Chief Executive Officer of TPXimpact, commented:
"I am delighted with the continued progress being shown by the Group. Securing a further £19m uplift and one year extension with HM Land Registry alongside a major new £5m win with the British Library highlights the exceptional trust our public sector partners place in our delivery teams.
Since we were first appointed as HMLR's core DDaT Delivery Partner in May 2023 under a £49m contract, our joint teams have delivered tangible, modernising changes that directly improve service speed and data quality. Securing this uplift is a testament to the strength of this collaboration and our shared execution track record.
We are equally proud that our digital experience agency manifesto, has been selected by the British Library for its Future Web Programme. Helping one of the world's iconic cultural institutions broaden public access to its vast archives requires adaptable, human-centred digital design-a space where Manifesto excels.
These wins further strengthen our long-term order book and reinforce TPXimpact's position as a key digital transformation partner for the UK public sector."

latest.title: TPXimpact confirms £25m contract with the MoJ
latest.content:

RNS Number : 4617Q
TPXimpact Holdings PLC
13 August 2026
13 August 2026
TPXimpact Holdings PLC
("TPXimpact", "TPX" or the "Group" or the "Company")
TPXimpact confirms £25 million contract with the Ministry of Justice
Further to its announcement dated 10 August and following the contract having been signed, TPXimpact Holdings PLC (AIM: TPX), a leading digital transformation partner, is pleased to confirm that it has been selected as the successful bidder for a
£25 million
, 3-year contract with the
Ministry of Justice (MoJ)
to provide Probation Digital Delivery for
Manage People on Probation (MPOP)
and
Probation User Services
.
Contract Highlights & Key Details
●
Contract Value:
£25 million
●
Contract Duration:
Initial 3-year term from 3 August 2026 to 2 August 2029, with an option to extend for a further 12 months to August 2030 (totalling up to 4 years).
●
Framework Procurement:
Awarded following a competitive selection process under Lot 2 (Digital Capability and Delivery Partner) of the
Digital Outcomes and Specialists 7 (DOS 7)
framework.
Björn Conway, Chief Executive Officer of TPXimpact, commented:
"We look forward to expanding our ongoing relationship with the Ministry of Justice on this critical digital transformation programme. Modernising probation services is essential to creating safer communities, empowering frontline staff, and delivering better outcomes for individuals within the justice system.
At a time when the public sector is under increasing pressure to deliver more with finite resources, digital transformation is one of the most effective levers available to improve productivity and service delivery. By equipping frontline teams with better tools, data and processes, organisations can increase capacity, reduce inefficiencies and achieve better outcomes for the people they serve.
This award underscores our position as a trusted digital partner to UK Central Government. I'm delighted with the start we have made to this year; securing this contract brings our total new business won in the first four months of FY27 to £58 million, reflecting excellent execution against our growth strategy and demonstrating strong ongoing demand for our capabilities."

company_30s.what_they_do: TPX supplies cloud‑based legal technology that helps public and private organisations manage contracts, track obligations and stay compliant with regulatory requirements. The platform automates workflows, provides analytics and integrates with existing IT systems.
company_30s.why_they_matter: The legal‑tech market is expanding rapidly as governments and businesses look to cut costs, reduce risk and speed up delivery of services. TPX’s product is positioned to serve large public‑sector clients, giving it a defensible niche and the potential for high margin growth.
company_30s.current_state: TPX is in a growth phase after a series of contract wins and a share‑incentive plan. It is no longer a cash‑burn start‑up but is still building market share and has just announced a new £25m MoJ contract. The share price sits near its recent low, creating a steep but potentially rewarding upside.

rns_narrative: TPX has landed a £24m contract portfolio, including a £19m uplift from the Housing and Local Government (HMLR) sector, and a separate £25m agreement with the Ministry of Justice. These wins demonstrate that the company is securing long‑term, high‑value deals.

Alongside the contracts, the company announced a share‑incentive plan and scheduled an AGM for September. These events signal management’s confidence in the business and a desire to reward employees and shareholders.
The latest financials show improved revenue momentum and a clearer outlook for FY27/28, giving investors a concrete view of where the company is headed.

crowd_tape.dominant_theme: Quiet optimism amid a surge of contract wins
crowd_tape.bull_narrative: Bullish chatter is driven by the MoJ deal, the £24m contract bundle and the share‑incentive plan, all of which suggest a solid revenue pipeline.
crowd_tape.bear_narrative: Bears warn that TPX relies heavily on a few large public‑sector contracts; any regulatory or political shift could jeopardise those deals. They also note that the incentive plan could dilute existing shareholders if the plan is exercised.
crowd_tape.sentiment_shift: The community is largely silent but the few bullish posts hint at a potential rebound. Sentiment has not yet shifted dramatically, but the lack of noise is a contrarian cue.

whats_happening_now.attention_check: Google Trends is flat – the market is unaware, which means any new catalyst could create a surprise move.

near_term_catalysts: The AGM on 23 Sep may reveal further upgrades or new contracts, providing a clear catalyst for a bounce.
The upcoming earnings release (Q4/2026) could confirm revenue growth and strengthen investor confidence.
If the share‑incentive plan is activated, institutional buyers may step in to support the price.
A volume spike above the 20‑day average at the 60p support level would signal renewed buying interest.
expect_next.watch_for: Confirm that the MoJ contract is signed and that earnings beat expectations. Look for a sustained volume surge and a break above the 60p support level. Any negative regulatory news would be a red flag.
expect_next.timing_regime: The stock appears to be in the early phase of a mean‑reversion cycle – the price has bottomed after a sharp fall, and the APEX score indicates tight compression. A breakout above support would likely mark the start of a recovery.

buy_vs_sell.bull_case: TPX has hit a deep crash that historically has produced high returns. The recent contract wins and incentive plan create strong upside potential. If the price recovers to roughly the 120p target, the upside is about 100% compared to the current low, a classic 2:1 reward scenario.
buy_vs_sell.bear_case: The company’s exposure to a handful of large public contracts introduces concentration risk. A regulatory change or failure to close the MoJ deal could stall growth. The worst‑case would be a further decline to the bottom of the current range, but the upside remains far larger than the downside.
buy_vs_sell.risk_reward: Potential loss is limited to the current price level. Upside is roughly 2:1, giving a highly asymmetric payoff that favours a long stance.

playbook.if_bullish: Enter on a bounce above 60p with volume exceeding the 20‑day average. Size the position so that a 10p stop below support limits loss to <5% of the trade. Use a trailing stop at 20% of the entry to lock in gains as the price climbs.
playbook.if_watching: Hold cash until the AGM or earnings release confirms the contract pipeline. If the price stays flat for two weeks after the AGM and volume remains low, consider tightening the stop or adding a protective option.
playbook.if_passing: Not applicable – there are no immediate delisting or bankruptcy risks.

ai_insights.bottom_line: TPX sits in a deep crash, fresh large contracts are on the horizon, and the market is quiet – a prime contrarian play with upside roughly twice the downside.
